notes: Recipe and item records are normalized from one pinned wiki data-module revision; this does not establish compatibility with a Palworld game patch.
The source does not identify crafting stations or technology unlock levels, so those fields remain unknown.
13 conversion alternatives that would introduce recipe dependency cycles are excluded; 1 cyclic-only output is treated as a raw acquisition boundary.

items.name: Wood
acquisition: Material for structures and items. Can be obtained by cutting trees.

items.name: Stone
acquisition: Material for structures and items. Can be obtained by mining rocks.

items.name: Venom Gland

items.name: Flame Organ
acquisition: Material obtainable from Fire Pals. Can be used to make Fire Arrow and more.

items.name: Ancient Civilization Parts
acquisition: Debris excavated from ancient ruins. Contains abundant information on lost technology. Extremely valuable, people from all walks of life are now seeking such crystals.

items.name: Nightstar Sand
acquisition: Sand that can be found in the desert at night.  Used as a material for crafting certain accessories and other items.

items.name: Ore
acquisition: Becomes an ingot when refined using a furnace. Can be found in caves and other places.

items.name: Hardwood

items.name: Lettuce

items.name: Tomato

acquisition: Raw slices of Skutlass.  Characterized by its supple, plump flesh. Caution is required when preparing it due to its sword-like spine.

items.name: Giant Pal Soul
acquisition: The soul left behind by a highly trained Pal. It can draw out hidden abilities if offered to a Statue of Power.
